title: Figure 4: Optical metamaterials for 1.5 um telecom and mid-IR IPM (micrographs, plot)
description: Three-panel figure: (a) an electron-microscope-style image of a multilayer silver/MgF2 fishnet metamaterial with labeled dimensions, (b) a micrograph of the focused-ion-beam-milled prism-shaped fishnet with a 1 um scale bar, and (c) a plot of permittivity versus wavelength (um) for an indefinite permittivity medium with layer inset. Caption: "Figure 4. Recent Optical Metamaterials for Telecommunication Wavelength λ = 1.5 μm (Left and Middle) and Mid-Infrared IPM." Text below discusses UT-Austin metamaterial research and aerospace applications.
